authenticity_review: The image exhibits high authenticity with no visible AI artifacts. The wood grain texture is consistent and realistic across all four figurines, lighting is natural with appropriate shadows, and anatomical proportions of the carved puppies are coherent. No melting, fusion, or structural defects are present. The perceptual quality auditor confirmed no noise, blur, or compression artifacts. Animal pose auditor flagged low confidence in hind limb keypoints (22% below threshold), but this is consistent with stylized wooden carvings where joints are simplified rather than biologically accurate - not an artifact indicator.
